err.fto_off: Field training is switched off on this server.
err.fto_same_officer: The trainer and the rookie must be two different officers. Pick another officer.
err.fto_trainer_offline: The trainer must be online and on duty to be paired. Try again when they are.
err.setting_fto_department: A trainer grade names an unknown department. Use a department key of Config.Departments (such as sast).
err.setting_fto_type: A task names an unknown mission type. Use a mission type in Config.MissionTypes (such as patrol or tactical).
err.fto_trainer_grade: That officer's grade is below the department's trainer grade. Pick a higher-ranked trainer.
err.fto_already_paired: That rookie already has a trainer. Unpair them first to change the trainer.
err.fto_trainer_in_training: That officer is still in field training and can't train others yet. Pick another trainer.
err.fto_rookie_trains: That officer is training rookies of their own and can't be put in field training. End their trainees' training first.
err.fto_trainer_full: That trainer already has as many rookies as allowed. Pick another trainer.
err.fto_not_paired: That officer isn't in field training. Pair them with a trainer first.
err.fto_not_trainer: Only the rookie's own trainer can sign their tasks off. Ask that trainer.
err.fto_task_unknown: That sign-off task doesn't exist. Refresh the screen.
err.fto_task_not_ready: The rookie hasn't finished enough missions with you for this task yet. Play more missions together first.
err.fto_task_signed: That task is already signed off. Nothing was changed.
fto.toast.paired_rookie: You are in field training. Your trainer is {name}.
fto.toast.paired_trainer: You are now the field trainer of {name}.
fto.toast.ready: {name} has finished the {task} missions: sign the task off in Profile.
fto.toast.done: Field training complete! {name} signed off your last task.
fto.title: Field training
fto.subtitle: Missions a rookie finishes with his trainer count towards each task.
fto.sign_text: The rookie is told and the sign-off is in the audit log. It can't be taken back.
fto.pair_title: Pair a trainer with a rookie
fto.pair_text: Trainers are online officers of grade {grade} and up; one trainer takes at most {n} rookies.
fto.none: No rookie is in field training.
fto.no_trainers: No trainer of this department is online.
err.fto_trainer_needed: You are in field training: this mission type needs your trainer in your unit.
err.member_fto_trainer_needed: A rookie in your unit needs their trainer in the unit for this mission type. Invite the trainer, or pick another type.
fto.toast.bonus: +{points} points for signing off a task of {name}.
fto.needs_trainer: With your trainer in the unit only: {types}
fto.bonus_hint: You get {points} points for each task you sign off.
